com.google.protobuf.Message, com.google.protobuf.MessageLite, com.google.protobuf.MessageLiteOrBuilder, com.google.protobuf.MessageOrBuilder, Serializable, DeviceCodeOAuthFlowOrBuilder
@Generated public final class DeviceCodeOAuthFlow extends com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessage implements DeviceCodeOAuthFlowOrBuilder
 Defines configuration details for the OAuth 2.0 Device Code flow (RFC 8628).
 This flow is designed for input-constrained devices such as IoT devices,
 and CLI tools where the user authenticates on a separate device.
Protobuf type lf.a2a.v1.DeviceCodeOAuthFlow
